name: Written Comprehension
definition: The ability to read and understand information and ideas presented in writing.

benchmark.name: RACE
benchmark.metric: accuracy (%) on RACE test set (RACE-M + RACE-H combined)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult / relevant educated workforce who read work-related written material in English

benchmark.name: RACE
benchmark.metric: accuracy (%) on the RACE test set (RACE-M and RACE-H combined)
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: literate adults who read written English material in work settings (general reading comprehension, not specialists)

benchmark.name: QuALITY
benchmark.metric: accuracy (%) on the QuALITY test set
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical adults whose work involves reading and understanding long-form prose, such as office, administrative and professional readers. They are assumed to read the full passage untimed.

benchmark.name: DROP
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: typical adult workers who routinely read and extract information from written documents, not trained expert annotators

benchmark.name: DROP
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: adults who routinely read and extract facts from written material at work (analysts, clerical and administrative staff, researchers).

benchmark.name: LongBench v2
benchmark.metric: accuracy (%) on the full 503-question multiple-choice set
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: college-educated professionals who read and analyze long documents (reports, contracts, codebases, data) at work. The published baseline comes from a comparable or slightly stronger group (domain-knowledgeable annotators).

benchmark.name: LongBench v2
benchmark.metric: accuracy (%), overall across 503 multiple-choice questions (reported by the source as 0.663 on a 0-1 scale)
benchmark.human_reference: Relevant educated workforce: college-educated professionals who read and synthesize long documents at work, such as analysts, researchers, legal and policy staff.
